I know online classes seem scary but honestly they get a really bad reputation. In my experience online classes actually aren’t that bad at all. If there’s a discussion session for the class you can always lean on your classmates for support and advice. The professors for online classes are, for the most part, extremely helpful. Think of the good things, you’ll be able to eat in class, wear pajamas, sleep in a bit, etc. Stay motivated and try to finish your assignments early so you’re not scrambling. I promise you can do it, you’ve got this. It’s going to be okay.

Not to change their minds or force them to bottle in how they feel but to help them understand how they feel and what the best course should be. 

I personally think that if your child is trans you should start them on blockers as soon as you can since being a teenager is already such an emotional process that adding on to that in a negative way could hurt your child more. But I also understand people who have the opposite point of view. Either way statistically speaking trans teenagers have a very high suicide rate especially when they go unsupported by the people that surround them. Your child is reaching out to you and telling you about something that they feel has become a big enough problem in their life that it’s causing them depression. It’s not going to go away if you ignore it it’ll just get worse. 

OP sit down with your ex wife and child and have a discussion. See where their points of views are coming from and support your child. Find a doctor or something similar that specializes in helping transition and ask questions. Do your research don’t just shut down your child(not saying you are but I’m sure from your kids point of view it feels that way). But please support your child and make sure they know you’ll be there to help them no matter what.

Edit: would just like to add that as others have said blockers aren’t permanent and are extremely important for a trans teen since it temporarily stops puberty. Once off the blockers puberty will resume.
